items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 83:1
items.html: It is similar to the Yesod of Atik, which separates between Aba and Ima and Yeshsut, as said above in answer 131. So it is here too. For the Yesod of Ima Ila’a is the phase of the posterior that interrupts the illumination of Hochma, and it bestows only Hassadim alone, hence the Hassadim there are covered. But from the chest of ZA downward, after the Yesod of Ima and her dominion cease, the Hassadim can be revealed in the illumination of Hochma. (Ibid.)
